description: Brilliant Jewels is a Match 3 game where you can either play against the time or try to pass levels with limited amount of moves. If you are feeling confident, you can also challenge the hard mode on the time attack mode. This game doesn't lack any sparkle!
instructions: Match three or more similar jewels to clear them from the board. Match four or more to receive special tiles. Combine two special tiles to create something even more special.

description: Enjoy Daily Mahjong with a sparkling jewels twist! Relax, match, and dive into the timeless charm of Daily Mahjong with a brilliant jewels theme!
instructions: Match identical tiles to clear them from the board. Tiles must be free on at least one side to be selected. Complete the layout to increase your daily streak and claim rewards. Use boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Undo, and Torch to help in tricky situations. Play daily to keep your streak going and earn bigger rewards over time. Stay sharp - your longest streak is waiting to be beaten!

instructions:
Player 1: W, Left Mouse Click, or Spacebar.
Player 2 (in 2 Player Mode): Up Arrow Key.
Mobile Devices: Tap anywhere on the screen to jump – touch controls are fully supported.

description: Ready to begin a fantastic match-3 puzzle adventure? Dream Mania - Happy Match is a fun puzzle game that you won't be able to stop playing. instructions: Mouse click or tap to play

description: In Bubble Plopper you can either try to prevent the bubbles from filling the playfield in Classic mode or try to clear the playfield within the given time in Time attack mode. Shooting bubbles has never been so fun. Plop plop!
instructions: Aim and shoot bubbles to match three or more of the same color to pop them. You can use the aim assistant or try your skills without it.

description: Sum Master is an engaging and challenging number puzzle game designed to enhance your mental arithmetic and logical reasoning skills. The objective is to select numbers within a grid so that the sums of each row, column, and colored region match the specified targets. Each puzzle has a unique solution, requiring players to carefully consider which numbers to include or exclude. The game offers a stimulating experience that combines fun with educational value.
instructions:
Select the numbers so that:
- Sum of numbers in every row equals the clue number on the right.
- Sum of numbers in every column equals the clue number at the top.
- Sum of numbers in every colored region matches the small number
inside that region.

description: Dive into the underwater world of Unblock It 3D: Atlantis and test your logic with endless brain-teasing puzzles! Rotate the puzzle cube to reveal which blocks you can slide away. Discover a vast collection of levels inspired by the lost city of Atlantis, featuring stone tiles textured like coral, shimmering pearl finishes, and sea flora woven through ancient ruins. Unlock new cube styles, explore vibrant oceanic themes, and keep your mind sharp as the puzzles grow more complex.
instructions: Clear the entire 3D puzzle by sliding blocks in the direction shown by their arrows. If a block isn’t blocked by another, you can swipe it away. Tap and drag to rotate the cube and view it from all sides — some paths are hidden from view and require careful inspection. Blocks come in different sizes, so plan your moves carefully. With no move limits, take your time and enjoy the calming rhythm of the deep as you unravel each underwater puzzle.

With eye-catching visuals, meme-inspired humor, and endless upgrades, Brainrot Clicker offers a weirdly satisfying experience you won’t want to stop!

You can generate brainrot scores with the MOUSE Left Click, W, Up Arrow Key or Spacebar. 
In 2 Player mode, players play with W and Up Arrow Key.

Match all the juicy fruits to clear the board as quickly as possible. Stuck on a level? Use handy boosters to keep the fruity fun going strong!

description:
Palm Island Solitaire – Your Tropical Card Challenge! ☀️

Score low, reshuffle when needed, and enjoy every move with playful golf lingo and island flair.

instructions:
Move cards from the tableau to the foundation if they’re one rank higher or lower - suits don’t matter. 
Kings are the highest, so nothing can go on top. Flip one card at a time from the stock when you’re stuck. You can’t move cards back, so plan ahead! The game ends when the stock is empty and no more moves are left.

-Checkers move diagonally forward; kings move diagonally in any direction.

instructions:

Solve with Strategy

Their ship is damaged, and they are stranded in the depths of the universe. To return home, you must solve engaging puzzles by matching elements and creating powerful combos. description:
In the game “Rope Sorting” you are waiting for exciting puzzles, where you need to sort the ropes. Pass an infinite number of levels, collect stars, use aids, be the first!

Rollback actions - allows you to return to the previous step to take a different path.

Adding a coil - makes it easier to pass a level by adding another empty coil.

The rules are simple:
- Only the top rope and only one color can be taken per turn.
- Select the desired spool, drop the ropes onto the empty spools.
- Connect and combine ropes of the same colors.
- Fill the spools.
That's it!

Release – Slow down

Noob decided to go into business and open his own shop. And what do all the people of Minecraft want? That's right - to eat!

Speed – outrun monsters
Arror – take damage

description: You start with 10,000 points and a blank map. Your objective is to retain the highest number of points by pinpointing five cities on the blank map.
instructions: Points will be deducted based on the distance between your guess and the actual city. The more accurate your guess, the more points you will retain. You can pan and zoom in or out for better accuracy.

description: Guess the hidden city by using compass directions and unlocking helpful hints like continent, flag, time zone, and name clues.
instructions:
Your objective is to guess the hidden city based on the clues provided. Start by typing any city name. Use the compass and distance clues to help you find the hidden city.

For every guess, a new hint about the hidden city is revealed. The hints include the continent, the current time at the hidden city, the flag, the city name length, and the city name’s starting letter.

You have six tries to guess the hidden city. Good luck!

description: Match pairs of emojis and word cards to uncover and learn about a significant historical event from around the world each day.
instructions:
Find the matching pairs of cards with emojis and words.
Click on the cards to reveal their content. Matching pairs will stay uncovered.
The colors of the cards show how many times they’ve been flipped:
Green: 1–2 flips, Orange: 3 flips, Red: 4+ flips.

Grow Stronger – Gain XP to upgrade stats like speed, tentacles, and stomach capacity.

description:
Challenge yourself with this captivating solitaire inspired by the classic Spider card game!

Arrange all the cards on the table into complete sequences of the same suit (from King to Ace), testing your logic, strategy, and patience.

Choose your difficulty level, play with one, two, or all four suits, and prove your skills with the deck.

Every move counts—can you complete all the sequences before running out of options?
instructions:
The goal is to complete descending sequences of the same suit, from King to Ace.

You can move cards or stacks in descending order, even if they are of different suits.

Once a complete sequence of the same suit is formed, it will be removed from the table.

If no moves are available, deal new cards by tapping the deck at the top.

Choose your difficulty:

 - Easy: 1 suit

 - Medium: 2 suits

 - Hard: 4 suits

Complete all sequences to win the game!

The snake moves forward automatically.

Your goal is to gradually remove all the tiles from the board. Use boosters to speed up the game.

Play Zen Master on different devices: computer, mobile phone, tablet.

We wish you good luck!

The puzzles start simple, but as you progress, the challenges become more complex with new elements to consider. description: 2048 Merge Circle is a fun and addictive number puzzle game with a twist! Rotate the circle, aim carefully, and shoot numbered balls to merge them. Combine matching numbers to upgrade them until you reach the ultimate goal—2048! It's a fresh take on the classic 2048 game with smooth mechanics and satisfying merges. Great for fans of casual games, brain teasers, and relaxing challenges.
instructions:
How to Play
Tap to shoot a ball into the rotating circle.
Balls with the same number will merge and create a higher number (e.g., 2 + 2 = 4).
Aim wisely to avoid filling the circle too much.
Keep merging until you reach 2048 – or go beyond to challenge your high score!
The game ends if the circle gets too full and there's no space to shoot

Destroyed ghosts can respawn as long as there are crates on the level.

Mushrooms also help destroy ghosts. Upgrade them to increase their power!
But be careful of the mummies! They immediately detonate a bomb. So run away to a safe distance!

Collect coins and buy upgrades.

description: Battleship is a classic strategy game where you compete against an enemy to sink their fleet of ships. Each player places their ships on a hidden grid and takes turns guessing the locations of the opponent’s ships. The first player to sink all of the enemy’s ships wins the game. It’s a test of strategy, memory, and luck!
instructions:
Setup: Place your fleet of ships on your grid. Ships can be placed horizontally or vertically but not diagonally.
Gameplay: Take turns with the enemy to call out grid coordinates (e.g., B5) to try and hit each other’s ships.
Hits and Misses: Mark hits and misses on your tracking grid. A hit means part of a ship is located at that coordinate; a miss means no ship is there.
Winning: The game continues until one player sinks all of the opponent’s ships.

But let us unfold the twist too.
The player can use a maximum of 5 cards only in order to add up to 21 otherwise he will lose a life. He can also lose if the grand total of the cards becomes more than 21.

The good part of the game is that there is no time boundation.
You can also get extra points with our additional features!
This simple card game will puzzle your mind for hours of enjoyment. Have a great time playing Cards 21 game. Play it NOW!

description:
Welcome Hex Warriors!

Hex Takeover is a turned-based strategy game played on different hexagonal boards. The objective is simple: conquer the most tiles to win.

How To Play:
During your turn tap on any of your tiles to chose your next move. Tiles can be cloned to adjacent spaces or they can jump to further spaces. Landing near opponent tiles will convert their tiles into yours! Cloning and Jumping have different implications on your strategy. Cloning a piece means that you get more tiles of your color on the board. Jumping sometimes could be beneficial if you spot enemy pieces further away but want to conquer them. The game ends when the board is filled up with tiles!

Seems easy right? Let's put your skills to the test!

Hex Takeover has simple game rules, yet the game can be quite a bit challenging! With different levels and varying difficulties, there are tons of different strategies to explore.

description:
Sploop.io is one of the best village building, crafting and PVP game. The PVP in this game is very easy to learn but it is really nervous and requires a lot of skills to be the top 1. You must collect resources to gain experience and build an unbeatable fortress. With the experience you gain you can then unlock new and more powerful weapons, as well as special buildings to make battles more interesting. To gain resources automatically you can place windmills, but you can also beat huge bosses that will leave treasures behind.  
Play several times and discover all possible upgrade builds and try to find the favorite build strategy that fits you best. Will you decide to use traps, turrets, spikes, or will you prefer to place buildings that use more to optimize your harvest? There are many possible strategies in Sploop.io  
  
Powerful gears

Build a Team

Clan wars are an essential component of this game, cooperation is very important. Will you decide to be a loyal person, or will you decide to be a traitor to defeat your worst enemies?  
  
Bosses and their treasures  
  
Face incredible bosses alone or in cooperation like dragons, mammoths, octopuses in this game. These bosses always protect an important treasure. Thanks to these treasures you can buy skins and accessories that will obviously make you cooler than all other players.  
  
Ranking

description:
The new version of the Plumber game is here. With 300 new levels, Plumber 3 is the new way to play the famous connection game where you just need to assemble the pipelines.   
   
While technology seems to be more advanced than ever, traditional crafts are losing the fascination and enthrallment they used to enjoy a few decades ago. As children, everybody wanted to be a fireman, a policeman or a plumber. Nowadays, I bet your dream job isn’t related with plumbing, at least until you start playing Plumber 3!!   
   
Just like in real life, your mission is to prevent leaks and deluges by connecting the pipes and allowing a successful flow through the pipeline. Instead of a physical effort, you will need to show some logic skills if you do not want to be flooded in problems.   
   
Plumber 3 tests your logic, your work discipline and the efficiency to manage resources, since you have a budget and you must use it wisely. Your goal is to find a usable path between the energy source and the factory, spending the less you can. You will notice your bank balance decreasing each time you move a pipe. On the other hand, the difficulty will increase every time you solve a new challenge. Only a great Plumber will prevail to all this bedlam!   
   
In Plumber 3, you will be wrapped into an enterprising environment, where the “let’s do it!” motto will echo in your head several times. This motivational spirit is also present in the way the game mixes reality with all the classic features Plumber had in previous versions. The soundtrack also appeals to that epic feeling of achievement! To be the best plumber, you will have always to plug the right strategy to the resources available. Saving money, you will enjoy more moves in further levels and you will be able to use the special features included into your red toolbox: a pickax, a blueprint and the undo button. All these tools will ease your job. In the end of each level, you will get a number of stars regarding the quality of your performance. You will need those stars to keep progressing in the plumbing world!   
   
Gratifications will be delivered every time you complete the pipeline and see the energy flowing through the pipes. That means you are being an excellent plumber. You can always challenge yourself to create the longest pipeline ever made, since the levels are continuous. Go for a Guinness Record, if you can! This is a perfect game to play in dead times, especially in stressful situations like traffic or in public transport. Can you finish a level between two subway stops? Unlikely, I would say.   
   
The Plumber is one of the most acclaimed game franchises worldwide and Plumber 3 is the best version ever released! Accept our challenge and let’s do some plumbing!   
How to play Plumber 3?   
Plumber 3 is very simple and intuitive. After a couple of levels, you will immediately understand how it works and everything will become clearer and clearer while you progress. As the difficulty increases, you will feel more than ready to offer solutions to harder problems. To complete the level, you have to rotate the pipes and create a perfect pipeline. Once the oil starts to flow, you got it!   
   
Can I save my game progress?   
The app saves your game progress, so you can resume in the level where you stopped in the previous game session. You can check that in the game map. This allows you to maintain your progress, always discovering new levels and different pipelines.   
   
Do I need to pay anything to play Plumber 3?   
Plumber 3 is completely free and you don’t need to pay to play the game. However, you can buy diamonds that will help you to use the toolbox features and solve the levels. Besides this, you can also remove the ads for a symbolical price and enjoy a cleaner version of the game.

Cyber Cars Punk Racing is a 3D car driving game with futuristic cars and theme. There are super vehicles, neon city, and many game modes. 16 supercars, 60 racetracks, 2 players, 1 free ride area, Hot Pursuit area, and a battlefield are waiting for you. This game has a vehicle purchase and development system, and you can race against artificial intelligence or drive freely.
Game Modes
Career
There are many areas in which you can test yourself in career mode. These areas are "Race", "Against Time", "Stunt", "CheckPoint", and "Fly Parkour" respectively. When the race is completed, you receive stars based on your completion degree. You can get a maximum of 160 stars in career mode.

There are 12 racetracks in "Race" mode. You race with 7 Artificial Intelligence and if you can enter the top 3 when the race is over, you have the right to move on to the next race track. When the race is over, you earn money according to the time you complete the race. In addition, the drift points and flight points you earn in the race also give you money.

In the "Time Against" mode, you race against time. There are 12 racetracks in total. When you reach the finish line, you rate it based on when you reached it. Get star ratings here. With these star ratings, you will be able to buy new and supercars.

In "Stunt" mode, you need to reach the finish line by performing stunts on 12 specially designed racetracks. Reaching the finish line in time by staying on the track on challenging race tracks takes talent.

In "Check Point" mode, you need to try to reach the finish line by overcoming obstacles on 12 specially designed racetracks.

In "Fly Parkour" mode, you need to try to stay off the road by reaching incredible speeds. You can get new vehicles with the stars you get in "Career". Also, with the money you earn, you can buy new vehicles and increase engine power.
Free Ride
Get ready for free rides in a big city. The free mode area contains large buildings, wide streets, stunt areas, and many mysterious areas. There are 60 gems hidden in the city. By collecting these gems, you can have new vehicles. The "Reward" table opens every 180 seconds. In this "Reward" table, you earn money based on your drift and flight points. If you wait 180 seconds, you will get good rewards. When the number of keys reaches a certain level, the vehicle is opened for automatic use.
Hot Chase
Police are chasing vehicles and want to catch you? Ready for this action-packed chase? In this mode, we have the "HP" value. Damages we take while fleeing from the cops decrease our "HP" value. So try to stay away from the cops. Be careful, the cops will always be after you. When your "HP" value is 0, you are caught. Cops arrest you. To top up your "HP", simply press the "Extra HP" button. This button will appear briefly when hp is 0.
Battle Arena
Get ready for an action-packed battlefield. A total of 8 racers will show their skills on the specially designed battlefield. There are 3 special abilities: "Damage X5", "HP +25", "SHIELD". You can crush your opponents by collecting these skills.

The last man standing wins. This mode is a mode in which vehicles try to crash and explode. Each vehicle has 100 HP and when the HP value drops to 0, the vehicle explodes. The competitor with 0 HP is withdrawn from the battle. Your HP + 20 increases when you detonate another. There are ranking rewards at the end of the battle. You must be in the top 3 to receive these ranking rewards. Lets! Get on the battlefield and roar like a lion.

Two Players (2P Versus)
You can compete with your friends on the same computer with a half screen. Prove who's the better driver.



Features
Cyber ​​future theme
Two-player mode
Neon city
Exciting race against artificial intelligence
Realistic driving physics
Wide range of racing cars to choose from
Wide open-world
Fullscreen mode available
